description.fr-FR: Les petits écrits de Thérèse qui ne sont ni lettres, ni poésies, ni prières : ses notes de retraite de première communion (1884), la « Concordance pascale » des Évangiles de la Résurrection, le mémoire qu’elle rédigea pour la cause de Mère Geneviève de Sainte-Thérèse (1890-1892), et les textes des images qu’elle peignit et offrit à ses sœurs (1888-1897). Transcriptions des archives du Carmel de Lisieux (édition du Centenaire).
description.en-US: Thérèse’s small writings that are neither letters, poems nor prayers: her notes for the retreat before her First Communion (1884), the “Paschal Concordance” of the Resurrection Gospels, the memoir she wrote on Mother Geneviève of Saint Teresa (1890-1892), and the texts of the holy cards she painted and gave to her sisters (1888-1897). Transcriptions from the archives of the Carmel of Lisieux (Centenary edition).
description.pt-BR: Os pequenos escritos de Teresinha que não são cartas, poemas nem orações: suas notas de retiro da primeira comunhão (1884), a «Concordância pascal» dos Evangelhos da Ressurreição, a memória que ela redigiu para a causa de Madre Genoveva de Santa Teresa (1890-1892) e os textos das imagens que ela pintou e deu às irmãs (1888-1897). Transcrições dos arquivos do Carmelo de Lisieux (edição do Centenário).

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Lisieux (Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire)

sources.edition: Archives du Carmel de Lisieux: /oeuvres-de-therese/ecrits-divers/notes-de-retraite/, /concordance-pascale/, /memoire-sur-mere-genevieve-de-sainte-therese/ (transcriptions read from the pages' json-cahiers data) and the 16 image pages of /oeuvres-de-therese/images-faites-et-donnees-par-therese/ that carry a "Transcription" (/archive/christ-en-croix-1896/ …), read through the REST API.
sources.description: Thérèse's text only. Left out: the editors' folio marks ("[1 v°]", "(2r°)"), the "Voir ici…" cross-references, the commentaries around the images. Nine images (nos. 9, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21) are not included: their pages carry no transcription, the text being the image itself; the school notebooks (Cahiers scolaires: history and geography exercise books) and the artistic works are not writings in the literary sense and are left out. Wrapped manuscript lines are joined.
sources.tierEvidence: Thérèse died in 1897; these writings were first published in 1988-92 or earlier by the Carmel; the 25-year right in posthumous works (CPI art. L123-4) has long ended. The site states no terms (its mentions légales page is empty, checked 2026-11-01); the editors' notes are not taken.
